name: Kadane's Algorithm (Maximum Subarray)
description: Finds the contiguous subarray with the maximum sum in O(n) time. The elegant insight: at each element, either extend the previous subarray or start fresh.
aim: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum by tracking current running sum and the global maximum, resetting when the running sum goes negative.
howItWorks: If currentSum < 0: reset to current element (start fresh)

realWorld: Stock trading — maximum profit from one buy-sell period
Signal processing — find strongest signal window
Image processing — maximum sum rectangle subproblem
whenToUse: 1D optimization problems with negative values possible
Base problem for 2D maximum rectangle problem
alternatives: Divide and Conquer — O(n log n), not needed here
Prefix sum — O(n) space, less elegant
Brute force O(n²) — never use when Kadane's is available
